title: 563. Keyboard Row

examples.explanation: Alaska uses only the middle row and Dad uses only the middle row; the other two mix rows.
The letters span at least two rows.
Both words stay within the middle row.

hints: Map every letter (lowercased) to its row index 0, 1 or 2 once.
A word passes when all its letters share the row of its first letter.
Adaptation: the returned string list maps to string_list; preserve input order.
